title: Outlook: Delimiter setting admin policy
description: Admins will be able to define a tenant‑wide default value for the Mail Compose and Reply setting that controls whether commas are used to separate recipients. Updated June 2, 2026: We are in the process of correcting an issue with setting the policy. We expect to complete in mid-June. Thank you for your patience.
